description:
Upstream defines ~50 app-level keybindings in `coding-agent/src/core/keybindings.ts` via declaration merging on the `Keybindings` interface. Our `Keybindings` module only defines ~30 TUI-level bindings (editor + select). The app-level bindings are entirely missing.

Add app-level binding definitions to Keybindings for:
- `app.interrupt` (escape) — cancel/abort
- `app.clear` (ctrl+c) — clear editor (currently hardcoded as exit)
- `app.exit` (ctrl+d) — exit when editor is empty
- `app.suspend` (ctrl+z) — suspend to shell (unix only)
- `app.thinking.cycle` (shift+tab) — cycle thinking level
- `app.model.cycleForward` (ctrl+p) — next model
- `app.model.cycleBackward` (shift+ctrl+p) — previous model
- `app.model.select` (ctrl+l) — open model selector overlay
- `app.tools.expand` (ctrl+o) — toggle tool output expansion
- `app.thinking.toggle` (ctrl+t) — toggle thinking block visibility
- `app.editor.external` (ctrl+g) — open external editor
- `app.message.followUp` (alt+enter) — queue follow-up message
- `app.message.dequeue` (alt+up) — edit all queued messages
- `app.clipboard.pasteImage` (ctrl+v) — paste image from clipboard

Ref: `coding-agent/src/core/keybindings.ts` L65-200.
title: Keybindings: app-level action definitions
